description.en: Starts changing a camera's depth-of-field level to a target value over a number of frames. Depth of field: the blur of what is out of focus, set per camera (see also the DepthLevel and DepthRange settings of CMND_SET_CAMERA_PARAM). Wait with CMND_IS_DEPTHLEVEL_FADE.
Length of the fade in frames.

true once started, false if the camera is not found.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 3 arguments are given.

examples.case: When a stand-up talk starts (real usage, from ie4_ev_main.nut, StartStandEvent)
When the talk ends (real usage, from ie4_ev_main.nut, EndStandEvent)
